entities.name: Theriad
entities.description: Epic poem of Theros compiling stories of champions of Heliod.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: Sun god whose champions the Theriad tells of.

entities.name: Champion of the Sun
entities.description: Title given to someone chosen by Heliod.

entities.name: Kytheon Iora
entities.description: Became Champion of the Sun on receiving Heliod's spear.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: Became Champion of the Sun taking up Godsend to kill Xenagos.

entities.name: Daxos
entities.description: Returned from the Underworld as a Demigod and made Heliod's Champion.

entities.name: Kaliaros
entities.description: Helmsman on a Champion's boat crew.

events.summary: Kytheon Iora became Champion of the Sun on receiving Heliod's spear to battle Erebos's Titan.
events.quote: Kytheon Iora became the Champion of the Sun when he received Heliod's spear

events.summary: Elspeth Tirel became Champion of the Sun and killed Xenagos with Godsend.
events.quote: Elspeth Tirel became the Champion of the Sun when she took up Godsend to kill Xenagos

events.summary: Heliod returned Daxos from the Underworld as a Demigod and made him his Champion.
events.quote: he made him his new Champion.
